proposal.title: Synthesis of Foundational Assumption Testing and Epistemic Self-Correction
proposal.summary: This research synthesizes evidence concerning the limitations of formal systems, as exemplified by Gödel’s Incompleteness Theorems, with recent advances in metareasoning and autonomous error detection in deep learning architectures. Gödel’s work establishes fundamental limits on self-consistency proofs within formal systems, implying that any sufficiently complex system cannot rely solely on internal derivation to guarantee its own completeness. Parallel research into Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) identifies a 'reasoning–answer hit gap,' where models fail to integrate verified facts into their output despite internal reasoning success. Techniques like MR-ALIGN and ABINet++ demonstrate that augmenting architectures with explicit, decoupled, or iterative correction mechanisms can mitigate these failures.
